verdict.rationale: Docs describe the full server-side flow: create applicant, create workflow run (returns SDK token), collect document+selfie captures via drop-in/hosted SDK, and retrieve results via webhook or polling — exactly the no-build-your-own-capture-UI flow described in the story. Also supports Smart Capture Link as a hosted no-code option and webhook signature verification for secure result reads. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration (blog posts, sample repos, or third-party integration reports) confirming the drop-in/hosted redirect flow works end-to-end in practice.
